review.notes: full review. Folder diff vs main (where #1857 is cbe6674f): two README hunks; Suggested.lean unchanged; nothing outside the folder. Both corrections verified: (1) Layer 3 example q_s = (-1)^(s+1) d^(2s-1)/dt^(2s-1) (t^2+1)^-1 matches DLMF 2.11.3 (q2 = -q''', q2(2) = 144/625) and the 3.2 endpoint expansion; at m = 40 the corrected series is accurate to 3.5e-14, the old signs miss by 3.7e-8. (2) 8.5: DLMF 2.5.43 sums residues over 1 < Re z < l with delta 'arbitrary small' (dlmf25 lines 1634-1682); the old 'every delta in (0,1)' fails on the PR's h = t^(-3/2) 1_(t>1) (pole at 3/2 on the line for l = 2, delta = 1/2); with an admissible delta, L h(zeta) = 2 - 2 sqrt(pi) zeta^(1/2) + 2 zeta - zeta^2/3 + ... is confirmed numerically. No previous finding open (r6 accepted with none). Seeded sample: all 15 targets read at their locators (dlmf21-dlmf29 via a scratch manifest; 2.10 and 2.11 on the DLMF site because the service returns image-only figure PDFs); 10.1 (Olver 1997 Ch. 6 s10) is paywalled and 8.7 has no external locator, so both were checked by computation. Adversarial table: 45 rows, all computed this round. Lean: elaboration exit 0 with only the 39 sorry warnings; #check sweep of 52 declarations exit 0, no lost binder; padding probe leaves all 39 sorries. 50 library declarations checked at the pins. Gate: the worker's gate and my own both pass; depcheck: 236 roadmaps, 2263 edges, 0 problems. Overlaps none; ownership checked against the open SpecialFunctions roadmaps and ExplicitZetaBounds (its Banach-valued Euler-Maclaurin names this roadmap's 13.1; reconciling it is for that PR). One source gap recorded (DLMF 2.2.1 continuity at a).
